answer:
**Login:** No server auth at all. `AuthService.login(username)` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`) checks `localStorage` for `ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>`; if found it loads that `UserProfile`, else creates an empty one with `campaigns: []` and persists it via `persist()` to both `ai_dnd_user_<name>` and the active-session key `ai_dnd_user`. `LoginComponent` just calls this and routes to `/characters` or `/game/<sessionId>`.

**Campaigns:** Stored only client-side as `CampaignSlot[]` inside each `UserProfile`, in `localStorage` keys `ai_dnd_user` (active) and `ai_dnd_user_<name>` (per-user). Each slot holds a pointer (`sessionId`/character ref), not the data itself — actual session/character state lives server-side in Cloudflare D1 (see `worker/src/services/session.md`, `worker/src/routes/character.md`).

**Deleting a slot:** `LoginComponent`'s delete action calls `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)`, which just does `p.campaigns = p.campaigns.filter(c => c.slotId !== slotId)` and re-persists the profile. Per the doc's explicit rule: *"`removeCampaign` only deletes the slot. It doesn't delete the character on the server."* The server-side character/session row in D1/KV is never touched — it becomes orphaned (still exists, just no longer referenced by any local slot).
